description: This file defines the Swift UI view 'GeneralSettings' which manages various application settings and diagnostics for the OpenClaw macOS application. It includes UI controls for toggling features, managing gateway connections, health checks, and log access, with supportive state management and network testing functionalities.

classes.name: GeneralSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that provides a comprehensive interface for application settings, including toggle options, remote connection configurations, gateway management, and health status diagnostics.

methods.name: refreshGatewayStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches current gateway environment status and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: testRemote
methods.description: Asynchronously tests remote gateway connectivity and updates remoteStatus to reflect success or failure.

methods.name: revealLogs
methods.description: Opens the log directory in the file viewer; shows alert if logs are missing.

methods.name: applyDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Applies a discovered gateway to the app’s shared settings, allowing user selection.
